applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
An account's legal owner cannot be replaced by another individual or company. A name change for the same company can be reviewed where the registration identifier remains the same. This includes a registered change of company name and appropriate changes between a Chinese name, its transliteration and its English form.

Provide the current business licence or company-registration certificate. For a company licence update, the unified registration identifier must match the existing company. A change of legal representative is a separate change request and must be identified as such. Personal identity-document updates must refer to the existing account holder.

## Portal changes

The English business address can be edited under My Account. Other address or legal-name changes use support review, with the registered entity and the type of address identified. If a company name beginning with a number cannot be entered in the English-name form, provide the company certificate and requested identity evidence for manual handling.

A security rejection when setting an English name may permit another attempt after 24 hours. A submitted name change normally receives a review result within one business day. If the error persists, supply its screenshot rather than repeatedly changing the legal name to an unrelated value.

Shareholder updates require the new shareholder's identity-document images, submitted through the registered email. A business-profile update is not a change to the owner of the account.
